svg.title: Goals down, status up
svg.desc: Three stacked boxes: Deliberative (slowest) on top, Executive in the middle, Reactive (fastest) below, and World at the bottom. Arrows on the left go down and carry goals: test the next cell at tester 1; pick and place in tester 1 (skills); joint commands (controllers). Arrows on the right go up and carry status: joint states and sensor data; GRASP_FAILED and tester 1 at -1 V, MALFUNCTIONING, in red; and cell 3 at 3.60 V with tester 1 down, in red.
